text:
kevin: Heads-up - release pipeline failed on staging while publishing sdk-js and sample-cli. regen diff introduced by typegen bumped client signature order and an x-sdk-defaults slip.

ci-bot: publish job 1974.09 failed - regendiff in `sdk-js/src/clients/runner.ts`
ci-bot: ```
--- a/sdk-js/src/clients/runner.ts
+++ b/sdk-js/src/clients/runner.ts
@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@
- export function buildOptions(token, opts = {}) { return { token, timeout: 3000, retry: false } }
+ export function buildOptions(token, opts = {}) { return { token, retry: true, timeout: 3000 } }
```

nina.qa: Reproduced in CI image. The regen also shuffled parameter order for the `Runner` client constructor which broke a handful of sample-cli integration tests. The CI publish step tried to bump version but then aborted with semver mismatch.

aam: typo - it's aaron not aam, sorry.

aaron: I dug in: the typegen diff came from openapi metadata that injected `x-sdk-defaults: { retry: true }` into the `Runner` schema. That caused codegen to emit `retry` earlier in the options literal. Semantically a minor change but it is visible to callers.

sam.engineer: Important: our release-stamp job expects a consistent regen pass. Because regen errored, the stamp step ran with stale changelog and wrote 2 different versions: package.json shows 2.0.7, CHANGELOG has 2.0.6. The publish step bails on that.

kevin: Quick plan: 1) revert the openapi metadata addition, 2) run typegen -> codegen locally and verify sample-cli e2e, 3) patch the release-stamp to do atomic version writes and fail early if regen diffs exist.

olga: I'll open a small change to release-sync to acquire a `.release-lock` file in the repo root during stamp and fail if the lock exists. That prevents race between parallel publish jobs.

ci-bot: note: regendiff check passed previously but only compares generated file hashes; small ordering changes still produce diffs that we treat as failures.

nina.qa: Also proposing a lightweight smoke harness that runs `node sample-cli/bin.js hello --dry` which asserts the printed options object contains `retry: false` (current expected). That would have caught the change before publish.

aaron: Revert PR opened: #3482 revert x-sdk-defaults on Runner schema. Added regression test in `sdk-js/test/regen-guard.spec.js` which diffs CLI output.

kevin: I pushed a tiny hotfix to the release job: the stamp now validates package.json == CHANGELOG header before publishing. If mismatch -> abort early with descriptive message.

devex-bot: Assigned issues: #3482, #3483, #3484. Milestone: release-hotfix-1974.

sam.engineer: FYI I noticed other typegen PRs occasionally reorder optional props due to the JSON schema map iteration order. We should make the typegen deterministic (sort properties) to avoid spurious diffs. I'll file a follow-up to add property sorting in the generator.

olga: Good catch. I'll include that in the eng-dev backlog. For now, the hotfix will keep the release moving.

kevin: CI for revert is running. If green I'll merge and re-run the full publish.

ci-bot: build 1974.10 started for PR #3482

kevin: Closing notes: regen diffs + release stamping are a hazardous combination. Short-term fixes listed above; long-term: deterministic typegen, regen gating in PR, and changelog/version atomicity. Thanks team. :shipit:
